name: – Isabel Wiseler-Lima – After § 4 – Am 34
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 4b. Strongly rejects the US and Israeli plans to expel Palestinians from the Gaza Strip and recalls that any deportation or forcible transfer of persons from occupied territory is strictly prohibited; reaffirms the fundamental right to self-determination of the Palestinian people, as recognised by the UN Charter; calls for a reparation process for the Palestinian State; demands the restitution of occupied territories and the return of the Palestinians who have been forced to flee their lands since 1948, to their homes;
